title: Professional Certificate in Overview of Duties, Rights, and Liquidation Under English Company Law
description: This course is designed to explore companies' duties, rights, and liquidation under the English Law.
longDescription: Understand the general duties of a company. Understand the role and rights of shareholders. Reflect on the rights and remedies available for minority shareholders. Understand the role and duties of auditors. Understand the duties and liability of directors. Understand the process and effects of a liquidation process. This course is designed to cover companies' duties, rights, and liquidation. The course covers the general duties of a company and the role and rights of majority and minority shareholders. This includes rules framing their rights to vote and act against the company and thus remedies available for minority shareholders. In addition, the course provides insight into the role and duties of auditors and the liability of directors.
